svg.aria-label: Gradient noise on one cell, from x = 0 to 1. With gradients +1 and -1 the two ramps, +1 × (x - 0) and -1 × (x - 1), are both 0.5 at x = 0.5, and the noise is a hump of 0.5 between the points. With +1 and +1 the ramps give +0.5 and -0.5 there and cancel, so the noise crosses zero: a hump, then a dip.
